_note: Runtime pricing overrides keyed by raw model name. Codex logs the better-ccflare route alias it was configured with as its model, so ccusage prices those ids at $0 and straude.com refuses any day with zero-cost Codex tokens (better-ccflare #343). Each alias is priced at its pool's physical model from LiteLLM: *astra -> gpt-6-astra, *sol -> gpt-5.6-sol; values are per token. Top-level defaults is the placement the unified `ccusage daily` report honors (verified 2026-09-11: the per-agent codex namespace only affects `ccusage codex daily`). Symlinked to ~/.config/claude/ccusage.json by lib/manifest.sh.
_estimates: unknown: OpenRouter's literal model label from Anthropic-compatible Claude requests before better-ccflare #261 (2026-08-14..18 here); priced at Claude Sonnet class as a middle estimate so cost-ranked boards that refuse $0 rows (straude.com) accept those days
stealth/ox-alpha: OpenRouter stealth preview model routed via better-ccflare (one day, 2026-08-25); nominal estimate for the same reason
codex-cloud-unattributed: cloud collector token deltas the attestation could not tie to a model; priced at gpt-6-astra because almost all attributed cloud usage ran on that model
